lines.text: SUB BY : DENI AUROR@ https://aurorarental.blogspot.com/ Are you ready, kids?

* who lives in a pineapple under the sea? * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * absorbent and yellow and porous is he. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * if nautical nonsense be something you wish... * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * then drop on the deck and flop like a fish. * * Spongebob Squarepants! * * ready? Spongebob Squarepants! * * Spongebob Squarepants!
Halloween is no different under the waves-- Pirates, skeletons and sea monsters...
Okay, Mister Krabs, the dishes are done-- I'm leaving.
Don't you want to hear my annual scary story?
Uh, does it have monsters in it?
Aye-- The worst monster of them all.
Hot, hot, hot, hot, hot, hot, hot!
Every year, on halloween night The flying dutchman descends on bikini bottom In a pirate ship...
Excuse me, did his ship look like a krabby patty?
Like i was saying, the flying dutchman swoops down And starts stealing people's souls.
Aye, as a matter of fact, they do.
Then he puts them where you can never get them-- In his soul bag.
Ha! Scaredy-Pants gets easier to scare every year!
Nothing like a good ghost story, eh, me boy?
Hope you're not too scared to come to me party tonight Spongebob scaredy-Pants.
Every halloween, no matter how hard i try, everybody scares me.
Sorry, i didn't mean to scare you.
Why can't i be frightening for once?
If you want to be scary You're going to need a good costume.
Great! You're going as my trick-Or-Treat bag.
I'm the ghost of the flying dutchman.
Little kids are easy to scare.
That was enough of a treat.
Spongebob Look at my new paper ghost.
What's the difference Between that ghost and me?
No, no, no, wait, don't tell me.
D-D-Don't tell me. I can do this!
I can do this, don't tell me, don't tell me!
I've got a square head And a real ghost has a round one.
All we have to do is make my head round And-- Boo!-- I'm scary.
You sure you want to do this?
Shave me down, make me round.
I don't know who i am!
I'm the flying dutchman's best friend.
Hey, don't you kids want your candy?
Your costume really packs a punch.
You scared the barnacles off that guy.
There's a whole party just full of people Down at the krusty krab And the flying dutchman is going to show up uninvited.
I guess he's been demoted to a haunted sleeping bag.
Oh, dad, you're embarrassing me again.
Howdy, Squidward... i mean flying dutchman.
What are you supposed to be?
Why, i'm a pet goldfish in a bowl.
You bet your lily white livers i'm the flying dutchman.
And i'll let you in on a little secret.
I'm going to steal your soul!
You had it coming, you big crybabies.
Every year, people dressing like me!
Turning the flying dutchman name into a laughingstock!
But that's not the reason i'm taking your souls.
No, th is the straw that broke the camel's back.
Out of all the dutchman costumes i've seen Yours is the most insulting.
Do you mean i'm not scary?
Let me tell you about scary, kid.
There's all kinds of scary things in the world.
Okay, let's get this over with.
First i got to get rid of this stupid costume.
I guess it was your pink hat.
Pink hat? Oh, that's not a hat.
We don't want you getting too thin.
The annual jellyfish convention in ukulele bottom this weekend.
I don't have anyone to take care of Gary.
Would you please stop leaving your undergarments On my front lawn?
Squidward, could you watch Gary this weekend?
You actually care for that thing?
I guess we can't go away this weekend After all, Patrick.
You mean, if i watch Gary You guys will be gone all weekend?
As in "not here for three days"?
Yeah, but you've already said you can't do it.
The three of us can still have Our own jellyfish convention At your house.
You guys deserve a weekend away.
Let me show you a little bit About snail care.
You need to take Gary for a walk twice a day...
Friday, saturday and sunday-- A three-Day weekend.
Let me show you how to feed him.
A can in the morning and a can at night.
Time to go. Don't want to be late. Bye-Bye.
You won't forget my instructions, will you?
I have the memory of an elephant.
I'll take good care of fred.
This is going to be the best three days of my life.
I'm going to do all the things I can't normally do because of Spongebob.
Well, thus ends the greatest weekend of my life.
No Spongebob, no Patrick, nothing but me, me, me.
The snail! I forgot the snail!
Eat, eat, eat, eat, eat, eat!
You've got to finish this food!
Just, uh, checking up on old Gary for you.
Well, i guess i'll see you later.
I can always count on you.
Yes, yes, it's just as i thought.
Oh, squid, did you hear that?
Therefore, a shot of snail plasma Must be carefully administered.
Oh, no, no, no, no, no, no, no.
Let me help you with your bag there.
I can't give Gary his plasma.
Oh, Spongebob, i don't want to...
Okay, okay, okay, okay, try it again.
You've injected me with snail plasma.
Well, you made me do it.
What's going to happen to me?
Oh, nothing, it's just a little snail plasma.
I don't know, i feel kind of funny.
I'm going to go home and throw up.
Nothing's going to happen to you.
Sorry, Gary, i couldn't control myself.
Gary, you're getting A lot faster.
That's okay, i'm a lefty, anyway.
Now i don't have to buy those new shoes.
I hope i never see another snail again.
As if i didn't already know.
Spongebob, i already told you: You're going to be just fi...
Oh, neptune, what have i done?
None of this would be happening if i'd only fed that snail.
